Kava and SOL led a volatile weekend for crypto. 📉

🏴‍☠️ An attacker reportedly sold about $2.1M in KAVA, sending its price down sharply. The team says the situation is contained.

🐳 Forward Industries reportedly sold 1.78M SOL for roughly $123M, while ETH accumulation continued.

🇨🇦 A Canadian healthcare pension fund reportedly opened a $35M HYPE position.

🔴 CoinGlass identified Coinbase spot as the main source of selling. Glassnode reported rising exchange outflows from large holders.

⛏️ Bitcoin mining difficulty fell 9.13%. Binance BTC open interest hit its lowest level since August 18.

Monday watchlist: CRO, AGT, and STBL unlocks; Enjin’s Matrixchain update; PancakeSwap’s planned CAKE buyback and burn.

Will fresh demand absorb the pressure, or will the downtrend continue?

RocketFuel Crypto

Crypto took a weekend hit. 📉

A reported $2.1M Kava exploit sent the token sharply lower. The team says it’s contained. Forward Industries reportedly sold 1.78M SOL for about $123M, even as ETH accumulation continued.

CoinGlass says Coinbase spot led selling. Glassnode sees more large-holder outflows to exchanges. Bitcoin mining difficulty fell 9.13%. Binance BTC open interest hit its lowest level since August 18.

CZ and executives at Strive and Bitmine tied the sell-off to buzz around a potential Anthropic IPO.

Also in the mix: a Canadian healthcare pension fund reportedly took a $35M HYPE position. A petition for Jensen Huang’s return as NVIDIA CEO topped 100,000 signatures.

Monday watchlist: CRO, AGT and STBL unlocks; Enjin’s Matrixchain update; PancakeSwap’s planned CAKE buyback and burn.

Will new demand catch the falling knife?

CryptoVolt
